about_the_game:
Your Average Platformer is a challenging 2D platformer about climbing to the peak of a city forgotten by God and mankind. Amid forgotten structures, tunnels, and overgrown ruins, the sky glows an eerie white. As one of the few survivors, you embark on a journey to find God and leave this forsaken world behind.

Game features:

• Distinct movement mechanics. Slide, dash, and climb through the ruins of the last city standing.
• Unique level design and mechanics. Ranging from dash refills to ziplines, the game has a wide range of level mechanics that each differ from each other fundamentally.
• 9 floors of gameplay and over 100 rooms of challenging platforming.
• Characters that each have their own story to tell about the crumbling world around them.
• Mysteries and in-depth lore about what truly happened to the city which you attempt ascending from.
• An immersive soundtrack of 20 melodies, composed by various artists.
• 6-8 hours of difficult gameplay, including challenges and bonus rooms.
• Two different endings.
• ..And a fallen angel who’s will to God lasts unwavering for generations on end.

Whether you’re searching for a challenge or an atmospheric ascent to prove your faith worthy, Your Average Platformer is the precision platformer that you’re looking for.

  • Processor: Intel: 2.0 GHz dual-core Intel processor or higher. Apple Silicon: Apple M1 or M2 chip
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics

mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 10.14 (Mojave) or later
  • Processor: Intel: 2.5 GHz quad-core Intel Core i5 or better Apple Silicon: Apple M1 or M2 chip for optimal performance
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM

short_description: An unnamed climber, you search for God in your ascent to the pinnacle of the city in which the remainder of the world resides in. A lone traveler accompanies you in your climb. Dash, jump, and climb your way to ascension in this challenging 2D platformer!
